item.title: Peterson Health ranked among top 20 rural hospitals in the nation – The Kerr County Lead
item.description: The Kerrville hospital will be formally recognized May 21 at NRHA's Annual Rural Health Conference in San Diego.

item.description: Rivera, Harris homer as Mountaineers top SCAC's first-place team

item.title: Texas Lutheran rebounds from opening series loss, rolls past Schreiner in doubleheader sweep – The Kerr County Lead
item.description: Texas Lutheran made itself right at home on Schreiner's campus Saturday, overwhelming the Mountaineers in both ends of a SCAC doubleheader.

item.title: Photo gallery: Bee Gee's Gold at the Cailloux Theater – The Kerr County Lead
item.description: The Bee Gee's tribute band "Bee Gee's Gold" performed in front of an enthusiastic audience on Saturday night at the Cailloux Theater.

item.title: Photo gallery: Kerrville annual disc golf tournament – The Kerr County Lead
item.description: The city of Kerrville's annual disc golf tournament was held on Saturday at Schreiner University's disc golf course. The tournament attracted players of all ages to try their skills on the course.

item.title: Photo gallery: No Kings Protest – The Kerr County Lead
item.description: More than 250 protesters opposed to the administration of U.S. President Donald Trump gathered on Saturday morning at the Kerr County Courthouse for a "No Kings Protest."

item.title: Photo gallery: Pint and Plow's 10th Anniversary – The Kerr County Lead
item.description: After a decade on the job, brewing beer and building community spirit, Pint and Plow owner Jeremy Walther decided he needed a party to give back and celebrate the Clay Street eatery and brewery’s status us a community destination.

item.title: William Burns: Dec. 14, 1927-March 24, 2026 – The Kerr County Lead
item.description: A person of strong faith, he served as elder, teacher, and board chairman at the First Christian Church of Laredo; elder and teacher at the First Christian Church of Kerrville; and elder, teacher, and jail ministry participant at the First Presbyterian Church of Kerrville.

item.title: Kenneth Hamill: Oct. 16, 1943-March 31, 2026 – The Kerr County Lead
item.description: Later in life, together with his wife during their extensive travels across North America, he authored and published Big Rigs Best Bets RV Directory.

item.title: Robert Cason Jr.: Jan. 12, 1956-March 21, 2026 – The Kerr County Lead
item.description: Bob loved God deeply and was known for his gift of healing through prayer. Many found comfort, strength, and hope through his faith-filled words and gentle spirit.
